note: A team is one way of running Claude Code. Every team gets the same fixture, the same task text and the same hidden tests. The main session is Opus 5.5 at xhigh effort for every team, so the comparison isolates what the harness changes. A team can extend another and override fields; the *-jev teams are their base team plus the decision gate on Jev.
